injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) is without a timetable for a return, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observer reports.

injuries.name: Coby White
injuries.detail: Head coach Charles Lee said Monday that White (calf) remains without a timeline for a return, though Lee added that he'll have a better idea of where things stand following the Hornets' two-game road trip, Rod Boone of The Charlotte Observe

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) will be re-evaluated following Charlotte's upcoming two-game road trip, Rod Boone reports.

injuries.name: Kylan Boswell
injuries.detail: Boswell (knee) is out for Wednesday's season opener against the Nets.

injuries.name: Patrick Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (groin) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.detail: Claxton (hamstring) participated in individual drills Monday morning and hopes to join the team for practice next week, Joe Cowley of the Chicago Sun-Times reports.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka
injuries.detail: Awaka (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Knicks.

injuries.name: Kyrie Irving
injuries.detail: Irving (knee) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Naji Marshall
injuries.detail: Marshall (illness) is now doubtful for Wednesday against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.detail: Aldama (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Lively (foot) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Caleb Martin
injuries.detail: Martin (thumb) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.detail: De Larrea (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Thunder.

injuries.name: Cameron Johnson
injuries.detail: Johnson (ankle) is doubtful to face the Pelicans on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Spencer Jones
injuries.detail: Jones (hamstring) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Alpha Diallo
injuries.detail: Diallo is out for Wednesday's game against the Pelicans due to personal reasons.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Ausar Thompson
injuries.detail: Thompson (ankle) is probable for Wednesday against the Hornets.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.detail: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.detail: Joe (hip) is out for Wednesday's game against the Hornets.

injuries.name: Yaxel Lendeborg
injuries.detail: Lendeborg (foot) went through Wednesday's morning shootaround, per Nick Friedell of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Alperen Sengun
injuries.detail: Sengun (back) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Marcus Smart
injuries.detail: Smart (forearm) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss time, though his timetable has yet to be announced, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Andrew Nembhard
injuries.detail: Nembhard (neck) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Aaron Nesmith
injuries.detail: Nesmith (hamstring) is probable for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Ivica Zubac
injuries.detail: Zubac (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy was diagnosed with a torn right ACL on Monday and will miss the remainder of the season, Michael Scotto of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Obi Toppin
injuries.detail: Toppin is probable to play Wednesday against the 76ers due to a left hand sprain.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Sheppard is scheduled for surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee Wednesday, Dustin Dopirak of The Indianapolis Star reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: McConnell (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Rui Hachimura
injuries.detail: Hachimura (quadriceps) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Lakers, Joey Linn of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.detail: Ingram won't be ready for the start of the season due to a partially torn Achilles, per Joey Linn of SI.com.

injuries.name: Max Strus
injuries.detail: Strus has been diagnosed with a partially torn plantar fascia in his right foot and he will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.detail: Niederhauser (foot) won't be ready for the start of the season, Law Murray of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Luka Doncic
injuries.detail: Doncic (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Ziaire Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (foot) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Adou Thiero
injuries.detail: Thiero (knee) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Cameron Carr
injuries.detail: Carr (oblique) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Simone Fontecchio
injuries.detail: Fontecchio (illness) is out for Wednesday's game against the Hawks.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.detail: Edwards will undergo arthroscopic right knee surgery and is expected to miss up to two months, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.detail: Missi has been diagnosed with a left knee bone bruise and he will miss an extended period of time, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Jose Alvarado
injuries.detail: Alvarado (ankle) is out for Wednesday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.

injuries.name: Ajay Mitchell
injuries.detail: Mitchell (ankle) is questionable for Wednesday's game against Dallas.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams has been diagnosed with a dislocated left ankle and fractured fibula, which will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace has been diagnosed with a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will require surgery, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Alex Caruso
injuries.detail: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.detail: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Sorber (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Mavericks.

injuries.name: Otega Oweh
injuries.detail: The Thunder plan to waive Oweh (Achilles) on Friday.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries.detail: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Anthony Black
injuries.detail: Black (personal) was not present at Wednesday's morning shootaround, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Isaac (knee) has been ruled out ahead of Wednesday's game against the Raptors.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jabari Walker
injuries.detail: Walker (knee) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Tacko Fall
injuries.detail: Fall (quadriceps) is out for Wednesday's game in Indiana.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is out for Wednesday's game against Utah, Paul Garcia of ProjectSpurs.com reports.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.detail: Leonard (knee) is expected to miss multiple weeks due to swelling in his left knee, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Magic, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.detail: Markkanen (wrist) is questionable for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Jaxson Hayes
injuries.detail: Hayes (shoulder) is listed as questionable for Wednesday's game against the Spurs.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Vukcevic (hip) will be re-evaluated in four weeks.
